livePreviewGrantFormation.result: Koios records and emits an InvocationResourceGrantDemand containing the provider's exact offer, invocation identifier, bindings, effects, and an explicitly proposed grant body.
livePreviewGrantFormation.authority: The proposed body is not a grant. The Leader Movement Team must author the InvocationResourceGrant response; Koios then supplies that exact response with --resource-grant on a later invocation.
livePreviewGrantFormation.credentialHandling: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is injected out of band only into the provider invocation, either from the inherited environment, a raw --credential-file, or an exact named assignment in --credential-env-file. Either file must be regular and mode 0600 or stricter. The client reads it only after validating the exact LMT grant; its path, variable name, and bytes are never placed in the demand, grant, contract, repository, or ledger.
